headline.title: Pre-season: cold nights ahead.
headline.text: 13 of the 31 resorts close to opening get nights cold enough to make snow, mostly in White Mountains and Western Maine. Killington typically opens first, around Nov 8.

BTV.excerpt:
Dry and cool through Sunday.
Increasing warmth early next week with possible light rain along the international border.
Breezes will be likely ahead of the next precipitation chances expected next week.

ALY.excerpt: ) Mostly dry weather is expected this weekend through at least the middle of next week, with increasing chances for rain later in the week.

GYX.excerpt: High pressure continues to dominate the weather through next week. Expect mainly dry conditions and no significant weather impacts.

BUF.excerpt:
) Cool and dry weather today.
) A warming trend begins Sunday with mild weather expected through early next week.

PHI.excerpt:
Some areas of frost tonight. Otherwise, generally tranquil weather is expected to prevail through the early portion of next week.
Rain is expected to return late next week.

CTP.excerpt: ) Lengthy run of dry and mild weather continues into early November before coming to an end by late next week

RLX.excerpt: ) Much of the area should remain dry into early next week, then a system brings widespread precipitation chances mid to late week.

writeups.name: Vermont
writeups.title: Dry, with cold nights.
paras: Next two days: summit temperatures from {{t:21}} to {{t:45}}, mostly dry.
Killington usually opens first here, around Nov 8. Jay Peak gets the most hours cold enough to make snow this week (about 22).
NWS Burlington forecasters, Saturday 2:42 AM: "Increasing warmth early next week with possible light rain along the international border."
writeups.outlook: Days 8 to 14: NOAA's outlook leans slightly warmer than normal and slightly drier than normal.

writeups.name: New Hampshire
writeups.title: Dry, with cold nights.
paras: Next two days: summit temperatures from {{t:22}} to {{t:49}}, mostly dry and gusts near {{w:45}} up top.
Bretton Woods usually opens first here, around Nov 15. Cannon gets the most hours cold enough to make snow this week (about 22).
NWS Gray forecasters, Saturday 6:30 AM: "High pressure continues to dominate the weather through next week. Expect mainly dry conditions and no significant weather impacts."
writeups.outlook: Days 8 to 14: NOAA's outlook leans slightly warmer than normal and near-normal precipitation.
